plan.major: Graphic Design, Graphic Arts and Media Technology
plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Graphic Design, Graphic Arts and Media Technology, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/graphic-arts-and-media-technology-graphic-design-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Graphic Arts and Media Technology Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines footnote 5 on this page ('See General Education requirements for AA/AS'); grid rows shown blank with units in semesters 3-4 do not name a specific course in the published schedule — modeled as choice slots; see advisor (catalog footnote 4: see Graphic Arts & Media Technology Faculty Adviser for sequencing of GAMT requirements). Designed to transfer to the BFA in Graphic Arts at UNR and the BA in Visual Media at NSU (no foreign language requirement); UNR's BA has a 0-14 credit foreign language requirement. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
